sentences.text: For the reasons mentioned in the application, copies of interim orders passed by the trial Court and status of other cases registered against the petitioner are taken on record, as Annexures P-7 to P-12, subject to all just exceptions.
Application is accordingly disposed of.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:163728 CRM-43261-2023 in/and CRM-M-33758-2023:

1. This is a second petition filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
on behalf of the petitioner, seeking grant of regular bail in case FIR No.14 dated 11.02.2023 (Annexure P-1) under Sections 420 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code,
registered at Police Station Ghanaur, District Patiala, Punjab.
2. After arguing for some time, learned senior counsel representing the petitioner submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the instant petition at this stage.
3. Keeping in view the aforesaid submission made by learned senior counsel for the petitioner, the present writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, at this stage.
4. All pending application(s), if any, shall also stand closed.
